meanings.tr: birinden ya da bir şeyden kaçınma, dışlama
meanings.en: the act of deliberately avoiding someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: The community's shunning of the outsider left him completely isolated.
meanings.exampleTr: Topluluğun yabancıyı dışlaması onu tamamen yalnız bıraktı.

meanings.en: to stop a business, machine, or system from operating
meanings.exampleEn: The company had to shut down its factory after the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket kazadan sonra fabrikasını kapatmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: to turn off a computer or device properly
meanings.exampleEn: Please shut down your computer before you leave the office.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen ofisten çıkmadan önce bilgisayarını kapat.

meanings.en: to stop the flow or supply of something
meanings.exampleEn: Remember to shut off the water before you go on holiday.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatile gitmeden önce suyu kapatmayı unutma.

meanings.en: causing disgust or a feeling of nausea
meanings.exampleEn: There was a sickening smell coming from the drain.
meanings.exampleTr: Giderden mide bulandırıcı bir koku geliyordu.

meanings.en: very shocking or morally offensive
meanings.exampleEn: It was sickening to watch how they treated the animals.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayvanlara nasıl davrandıklarını izlemek iğrençti.

meanings.tr: yan hikaye, ana olay örgüsünün dışındaki alt anlatı
meanings.en: a secondary narrative that is separate from the main plot
meanings.exampleEn: The novel has a charming side story about the hero's grandmother.
meanings.exampleTr: Romanda kahramanın büyükannesiyle ilgili sevimli bir yan hikaye var.

meanings.en: a minor or less important street off a main road
meanings.exampleEn: We parked the car in a quiet side street near the market.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabayı pazarın yakınındaki sessiz bir ara sokağa park ettik.

meanings.en: a military operation in which forces surround a place to force its surrender
meanings.exampleEn: The city endured a long siege before it finally fell.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir sonunda düşmeden önce uzun bir kuşatmaya dayandı.

meanings.en: the act of registering or enrolling for something
meanings.exampleEn: The website offers a free trial with every sign-up.
meanings.exampleTr: Web sitesi her kayıtla ücretsiz bir deneme sunuyor.

meanings.en: foolish or lighthearted behavior lacking seriousness
meanings.exampleEn: The children's silliness made everyone at the party laugh.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocukların saçmalıkları partideki herkesi güldürdü.

meanings.en: the use of plain, easy-to-understand language
meanings.exampleEn: The contract was rewritten in simple wording so everyone could understand it.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşme herkesin anlayabilmesi için yalın bir ifadeyle yeniden yazıldı.

meanings.en: the quality of being wicked or morally wrong
meanings.exampleEn: The preacher warned his congregation about the sinfulness of greed.
meanings.exampleTr: Vaiz cemaatini açgözlülüğün günahkârlığı konusunda uyardı.

meanings.en: to drink in small amounts while making a loud sound
meanings.exampleEn: He would sip noisily at his tea, which annoyed his colleagues.
meanings.exampleTr: Çayını höpürdeterek içerdi, bu da iş arkadaşlarını rahatsız ederdi.

meanings.en: to move into a seated position
meanings.exampleEn: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen otur ve rahatına bak.

meanings.en: the number 6
meanings.exampleEn: There are six chairs around the table.
meanings.exampleTr: Masanın etrafında altı sandalye var.

meanings.en: the number 16
meanings.exampleEn: She will be sixteen years old next month.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelecek ay on altı yaşına girecek.

meanings.en: the number 60
meanings.exampleEn: My grandfather retired when he was sixty.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükbabam altmış yaşındayken emekli oldu.

meanings.en: a person who doubts or questions accepted beliefs or claims
meanings.exampleEn: As a skeptic, she refused to believe the story without proof.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir kuşkucu olarak, kanıt olmadan hikayeye inanmayı reddetti.

meanings.en: an attitude of doubt about the truth of something
meanings.exampleEn: The new proposal was met with a great deal of skepticism.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni öneri büyük bir şüphecilikle karşılandı.

meanings.en: to distort or bias something so it is no longer accurate
meanings.exampleEn: A few extreme values can skew the average of the whole dataset.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç uç değer tüm veri kümesinin ortalamasını çarpıtabilir.

meanings.en: in a way that shows great ability or expertise
meanings.exampleEn: She skilfully negotiated a better deal for the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm ekip için daha iyi bir anlaşmayı ustalıkla müzakere etti.

meanings.en: to read or deal with something quickly without giving it detailed attention
meanings.exampleEn: I only had time to skim over the report before the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıdan önce rapora sadece göz gezdirecek vaktim vardı.

meanings.en: (British informal) a person who avoids work or duties
meanings.exampleEn: The manager called him a skiver for taking so many sick days.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür, bu kadar çok hastalık izni aldığı için ona kaytarıcı dedi.

meanings.en: a person who avoids work or effort, especially through laziness
meanings.exampleEn: He has a reputation as a slacker who never meets deadlines.
meanings.exampleTr: Asla teslim tarihlerine yetişmeyen bir kaytarıcı olarak nam salmış.

meanings.tr: düzgün ve parlak, şık ve modern görünümlü
meanings.en: smooth, glossy, and elegant in appearance
meanings.exampleEn: She drove a sleek black sports car.
meanings.exampleTr: Şık, siyah bir spor araba kullanıyordu.

meanings.en: the quality of being thin or slender
meanings.exampleEn: The model was admired for the slimness of her figure.
meanings.exampleTr: Model, vücudunun inceliğiyle takdir topluyordu.

meanings.en: in a careless, untidy, or messy way
meanings.exampleEn: The report was written so sloppily that no one could follow it.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor o kadar özensiz yazılmıştı ki kimse takip edemedi.

meanings.en: to reduce speed or become less active
meanings.exampleEn: You should slow down when you approach the school.
meanings.exampleTr: Okula yaklaşırken yavaşlamalısın.

meanings.en: to make something happen at a slower rate
meanings.exampleEn: Rising interest rates can slow down economic growth.
meanings.exampleTr: Yükselen faiz oranları ekonomik büyümeyi yavaşlatabilir.

meanings.en: the state of being slow, inactive, or lacking energy
meanings.exampleEn: The sluggishness of the economy worried investors.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekonominin durgunluğu yatırımcıları endişelendirdi.

meanings.en: clever in a deceptive or secretive way
meanings.exampleEn: He gave a sly smile as if he knew a secret.
meanings.exampleTr: Sanki bir sır biliyormuş gibi kurnaz bir gülümseme sergiledi.

meanings.en: a letter written in its lower-case form
meanings.exampleEn: Write your name in small letters, not capitals.
meanings.exampleTr: Adını büyük harflerle değil, küçük harflerle yaz.

meanings.en: a worker who makes or repairs metal objects, especially a blacksmith
meanings.exampleEn: The village smith forged a new set of horseshoes.
meanings.exampleTr: Köyün demircisi yeni bir takım at nalı dövdü.

meanings.en: the quality of being even, free from roughness or interruptions
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone praised the smoothness of the new car's ride.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes yeni arabanın sürüşünün pürüzsüzlüğünü övdü.

meanings.en: to kill someone by covering their nose and mouth so they cannot breathe
meanings.exampleEn: The murderer tried to smother his victim with a pillow.
meanings.exampleTr: Katil kurbanını bir yastıkla boğmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: to suppress or stifle something such as a feeling or fire
meanings.exampleEn: She tried to smother her laughter during the ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Tören sırasında kahkahasını bastırmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: a self-satisfied expression showing excessive pride in oneself
meanings.exampleEn: He wore a smug smile after winning the argument.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışmayı kazandıktan sonra kendini beğenmiş bir gülümseme takındı.

meanings.en: the crime of moving goods illegally into or out of a country
meanings.exampleEn: The police cracked down on cigarette smuggling at the border.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis sınırdaki sigara kaçakçılığına karşı sert önlemler aldı.

meanings.en: to buy or take something quickly and eagerly before others can
meanings.exampleEn: Shoppers snapped up the discounted laptops within minutes.
meanings.exampleTr: Alışverişçiler indirimli dizüstü bilgisayarları dakikalar içinde kapış kapış aldı.

meanings.tr: ön izleme, gizlice ilk bakış, önden gösterim
meanings.en: an early or secret look at something before it is officially available
meanings.exampleEn: The studio released a sneak peek of the upcoming film.
meanings.exampleTr: Stüdyo yaklaşan filmin bir ön izlemesini yayınladı.

meanings.en: the state of being sober or serious and not affected by alcohol
meanings.exampleEn: The soberness of his tone made everyone listen carefully.
meanings.exampleTr: Ses tonundaki ciddiyet herkesi dikkatle dinlemeye itti.

meanings.en: a piece of grass-covered surface soil held together by its roots
meanings.exampleEn: They laid fresh sod across the entire back garden.
meanings.exampleTr: Arka bahçenin tamamına taze çim tabakası serdiler.

meanings.en: water containing dissolved carbon dioxide, giving it bubbles
meanings.exampleEn: She mixed the juice with a splash of soda water.
meanings.exampleTr: Meyve suyunu biraz sodayla karıştırdı.

meanings.en: in a formal and serious manner
meanings.exampleEn: He solemnly swore to tell the truth in court.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkemede gerçeği söyleyeceğine ciddiyetle yemin etti.

meanings.en: unity and mutual support among a group with shared interests
meanings.exampleEn: The workers stood in solidarity with the striking miners.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler grevdeki madencilerle dayanışma içinde durdu.

meanings.tr: solist, tek başına performans sergileyen sanatçı
meanings.en: a musician or singer who performs alone or a solo part
meanings.exampleEn: The violin soloist received a standing ovation.
meanings.exampleTr: Keman solisti ayakta alkışlandı.

meanings.en: an unspecified amount or number of something
meanings.exampleEn: Would you like some coffee before we start?
meanings.exampleTr: Başlamadan önce biraz kahve ister misin?

meanings.en: used to refer to certain members of a group without specifying which
meanings.exampleEn: Some people prefer tea, while others prefer coffee.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı insanlar çayı tercih ederken, bazıları kahveyi tercih eder.

meanings.en: an unknown or unspecified person
meanings.exampleEn: Somebody left their umbrella in the meeting room.
meanings.exampleTr: Biri şemsiyesini toplantı odasında bırakmış.
